AgentCore harness — Observability and cost controls (harness-operations.html)
FIRST FULL AUDIT 2026-09-28. Literal facts.

=== CLOUDTRAIL (#harness-cloudtrail) — THE FINDING ===
"Harness operations are logged to AWS CloudTrail as management events (control plane) and
data events (data plane). In CloudTrail, harness resources appear under the
`AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime` resource type RATHER THAN A HARNESS-SPECIFIC TYPE.
Harness is a managed abstraction over AgentCore Runtime, and CloudTrail events reflect the
underlying runtime resource for consistency."

ALL harness CloudTrail events use resources.type = AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Runtime.
Event names:
  Management: CreateHarness, UpdateHarness, DeleteHarness, GetHarness, ListHarnesses
  Data:       InvokeAgentRuntime, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell

*** "Data plane operations appear as InvokeAgentRuntime, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand, and
    InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell in CloudTrail, matching the underlying Runtime API."
    -> THERE IS NO `InvokeHarness` EVENT NAME IN CLOUDTRAIL. An InvokeHarness call is
    indistinguishable by event name from a plain AgentCore Runtime invocation. ***
"The resources.ARN field contains the HARNESS ARN for control plane events and the
RUNTIME ARN for data plane events." -> control-plane and data-plane events for the same
harness carry DIFFERENT ARNs; correlation requires the harness->runtime mapping.

=== OBSERVABILITY ===
Every invocation auto-generates traces/logs/metrics via AgentCore Observability in
CloudWatch. "Model calls, tool invocations, memory operations, shell commands: each step
appears with timing and payload details. No extra configuration."
*** PRECONDITION: "Before you see traces, enable Transaction Search in CloudWatch
    (one-time per account)." -> traces are NOT on by default at the account level. ***
Telemetry flows through the harness EXECUTION ROLE (so a role missing the logs/xray
statements silently produces no trace).
"Observability explains activity but is not a billing report."

=== EXECUTION LIMITS (#harness-limits) ===
maxIterations            reasoning/action cycles per invocation. Default 75.
timeoutSeconds           wall-clock timeout for a single invocation. Default 3600.
maxTokens                token budget per invocation. Default N/A.
idleRuntimeSessionTimeout  how long an idle microVM stays warm. Default 900.
maxLifetime              max lifetime of a microVM session. Default 28800 (8h).
"All limits are optional; omit them to use service defaults."
*** Limits can be OVERRIDDEN PER INVOCATION: passing maxIterations, timeoutSeconds or
    maxTokens in invoke_harness overrides the configured harness defaults — a caller can
    raise a control-plane-set bound at call time. ***
CLI --truncation-strategy accepts sliding_window or summarization.

=== TAGS ===
Harness tags PROPAGATE to the managed Runtime, Runtime endpoint, and managed Memory created
for the harness. Separately created resources (Gateway, EFS, S3, BYO Memory) do NOT inherit.

=== COST SURFACE (billable capability list) ===
AgentCore Runtime (per-second CPU + peak memory from microVM start to termination),
model inference, AgentCore Memory (events written / records stored / retrievals),
Browser and Code Interpreter, Gateway and Web Search, Observability (CloudWatch),
storage and network (ECR/S3/EFS/data transfer).
Note: Browser and Code Interpreter "tool definitions can still add model input tokens when
allowed, even if the agent doesn't call them."
